Hope you’re well — we’re gearing up for a procurement review at HeliosAI and would like to run a focused security governance workshop with Redwood next week. Our primary goals are:
- Understand Redwood’s CAIQ/SIG posture and any SOC 2 coverage
- Identify the specific artifacts we’ll need (logs, configurations, policy docs)
- Walk through your evidence delivery cadence and point people

Would you be able to run a 60–90 minute session? Tentative attendees from our side: Priya Sharma (Head of InfoSec), myself (Cloud Security), plus one application owner.

Preferred windows:
- Tue 7/7 11:00–12:30 PT
- Wed 7/8 09:00–10:30 PT

We have a preliminary question bank attached to this email (HeliosAI_prelim_question_bank.xlsx) — it’s short but will help focus the call. If you can share a prep pack and suggested internal attendees from Redwood, that’d be great.

Thanks,
